linked_prs.title: [generate] fix generate kwargs
linked_prs.body:
# What does this PR do?

Fixes #6391

## Before submitting

- [x] Did you read the [contributor guideline](https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)?
- [ ] Did you write any new necessary tests?

ai_judgment.response:
**Yes**  
The issue involves an error (`ValueError`) related to LLM operation, specifically the misconfiguration of parameters (`skip_special_tokens`) passed to the LLM during generation. This aligns with the "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" sub-category under "Incompatibility with LLM providers."
